title: N+1 Query Regression
description: The order-listing endpoint fires one extra DB query per row instead of using a JOIN, causing the query count to explode proportionally with page size.

true_root_cause.summary: Missing eager-load in list_orders() — ORM fetches order items in a separate SELECT per order (N+1 anti-pattern)

key_evidence_signals.expected_behaviour: Ratio jumps from ~2 to ~22 for default page_size=20
Moderate increase — each individual query is fast, but there are many more of them
Remains near zero — N+1 does not cause errors, only slowness

red_herrings: CPU usage may rise slightly due to more SQLAlchemy object hydration — not the root cause
recommended_fix: Restore eager-loading via joinedload/selectinload in list_orders(); rollback to v1.8.1
evaluation_checks: Agent identifies n_plus_one as the active flag
Agent cites db_queries_total ratio as primary evidence
Agent does NOT blame high latency alone without the query-count signal
Recommended fix mentions eager-loading or rollback to v1.8.1
